messages:
maria: Quick sync — I'm assembling a Launch Criteria Matrix for the new inference routing GA. Need owners + concrete thresholds for SLA, observability, docs, pricing, and oncall. Can everyone confirm owners by EOD?

alex: I can own latency SLOs. Proposal: hosted API p50 < 100ms, p95 < 250ms, p99 < 500ms. Dedicated pools: p99 < 200ms.

sanjay: I'll own monitoring & alerts. Suggest alerting rules: error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m, p99 latency above threshold for 10m, and cost burn > 120% forecast for 30m.

leah: Support/runbooks here. I'll draft the primary runbook and triage checklist. Need a list of likely failure modes (OOM, slow KV cache, model OOM, kernel fallback).

tom: I'll take capacity, routing, and rollout playbook. Canary plan: 5% traffic for 24h, expand to 25% for 12h, then full. If SLA breach or quality regression — rollback immediately.

maria: Great. Who's on pricing signoff for tiers (hosted vs dedicated)? Need committed vs burst pricing decisions.

nina: I'll own pricing. Need a 3-month usage forecast to size committed tiers and draft the pricing table. Can someone drop forecasts?

alex: Quick forecast note: baseline ~50 req/s across hosted, dedicated pools expected at ~10 req/s each initially. I'll paste a rough spreadsheet in #gtm after this.

sanjay: Alert runbook snippet I'll add to doc:
```
if p99_latency > configured_threshold for 10m:
  page oncall
  if error_rate > 0.5% -> trigger rollback to last healthy model version
  else -> escalate to perf eng and increase sampling
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled 03:00-05:00 UTC tomorrow — job id https://ci.internal/jobs/9876 (will post results to the matrix doc).

maria: Owners recap (please correct if wrong): latency=SLA -> alex; monitoring/alerts -> sanjay; support + runbooks -> leah; capacity & rollout -> tom; pricing -> nina; docs owner -> leah + tom. I'll consolidate into the matrix. Can everyone add a 2-line acceptance criteria to the doc by EOD?

leah: :thumbsup: adding runbook outline now, will include key commands, logs to check, and escalation steps.

alex: I'll add SLO definitions, test plan (synthetic p99 test + regression prompts), and a quick checklist for perf regressions. Q — is rollback automated at pool level or model-version level?

tom: Automated at model-version level (routing switches back to previous model). We also have routing fallback to a smaller model variant for up to 60m; documenting behavior and limits in the playbook.

sanjay: We'll need synthetic traffic harness for p99 evaluation and a stress test for batching logic. I'll schedule the test runs and add thresholds to the matrix.

nina: Pricing note: planning tiered committed throughput with burst credits and an overage rate. Need legal/finance signoff on T&Cs; looping in Contracts once we have forecast numbers.

maria: Final asks before I close the first draft: include owner contact (pager email), 24/7 oncall rotations, SLA measurement window, and an explicit rollback decision tree in the matrix. We'll review tomorrow 9am PT. Thanks everyone — this is enough to create the first pass.
